description: A note written on the back of a work order, the ink run where a damp hand held it.

//: Level 2 notes: at the landing, in junk heaps and boiler lockers. Hints, not instructions; some are wrong.

text.text: The middle corridors always go through.  The side ones end in walls.  Stay in the middle.
Red wheel, BLEED tag.  Turn it and the hissing stops.  Turn it and everything for a long way hears you do it.
Drink before you're thirsty.  By the time you're thirsty down here it's too late to be comfortable.
The stairs fell in behind me.  There are ladders up.  Ladders.  Plural.  Somewhere.
The crew trade fair.  Don't touch their wheels.  Don't touch their water.
Boiler rooms have the good stuff and they will cook you for it.  Go in fast, come out faster.
Something walks on top of the pipes.  You can hear it keep pace with you.  It stops when you stop.
Day 9.  The water in the dips is warm as a bath.  It isn't clean.  I keep forgetting it isn't clean.
Somebody said there are offices further down.  Carpet.  Quiet.  Cold air.  I'd give my last boot for cold air.

//: Paint and marker on the pipes and walls.
